plugins.name: ia
plugins.description: InventArch's one public plugin: the Work, Knowledge and Delivery lanes resolve the bound method kit as a packet, with ia-method, ia-kb and ia-authoring as defaults; Delivery also routes UX, UI, brand, typography, token and accessibility work to the hosted design service when an account is connected.
